answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 145738 Country: India Title: If someone's wudhu breaks after 3 or 4 circle (tawaf) during tawaf then from where he will start his tawaf after making wudhu? Question: If someone's wudhu breaks after 3 or 4 circle (tawaf) during tawaf then from where he will start his tawaf after making wudhu? Answer ID: 145738 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 101/96/M=2/1438) If wudhu breaks during tawaf then it is necessary to stop it. If wudhu broke after completing four rounds of tawaf then after making wudhu one is free either to complete the remaining rounds or start the tawaf afresh. But if wudhu broke before completing the four rounds then it is better to perform the tawaf again. However, it is also lawful if one completes the remaining rounds of tawaf . أو تجديد وضوء ثم عاد بنى لو كان ذلك بعد إثيان أكثره ولو استأنف لا شيئ عليه الخ ويستحب الاستيناف في الطواف إذا كان قبل إتيان أكثره (غنية الناسك 127) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
